widgets.text: An action-adventure in the Dinotopia world: health and items are shown in the game's own HUD (no live data yet).
Move, attack and jump with the face buttons; talk to people and dinosaurs to get quests and hints.
The Timestone Pirates and their beasts: hit, step back, hit again; dodge charges sideways.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Travel between Dinotopia's towns and wilds while chasing the stolen Timestones.
Collect timestones and quest items; healing pickups restore health.
The story is about recovering the Timestones the pirates took.
Linear chapters; the game saves between them.
